Resource_Provisioner.message: Logistics status for this planning phase: no critical alerts, no deficit requests pending. Inventory snapshots show both hospitals above minimum operating buffers on all resource lines. I am monitoring the queue and will act immediately on any URGENT or DEFICIT request — if your department anticipates a shortfall for upcoming steps, post the resource type and target quantity and I will top up in one go. Please avoid speculative requests; only ask for what your scheduled steps will actually consume.
